tasks.title: ClawRouter HTTP Gateway — Express server (scripts/services/clawrouter-http-server.ts)
tasks.description:
Complete scripts/services/clawrouter-http-server.ts — an Express HTTP service that wraps clawrouter-v2.ts for architecture-level §17 compliance.

Full implementation required:

1. Import express, fs, path, routeCall (from '../lib/clawrouter-v2')
2. In-memory stats: { callsToday: number, costTodayUsd: number, startTime: Date, perTier: Record<string, {calls:number, cost:number, latencyMs:number[]}> }
3. JSONL log helper: logRequest(entry) — appends to logs/clawrouter/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl (create dir if needed)
4. POST /route:
   - Parse body as RouteCallParams
   - Record start time
   - Call await routeCall(params)
   - Compute latency_ms
   - Log entry: {ts, agent_id, task_type, tier, model, local, cost_usd, latency_ms, ok:true}
   - Update in-memory stats
   - Return {content, cost_usd, model, tier, local, latency_ms}
   - On error: log {ok:false, error}, return 500 {error: message}
5. GET /health:
   - Returns {status:'ok', uptime_s: Math.floor((Date.now()-startTime)/1000), calls_today: stats.callsToday, cost_today_usd: stats.costTodayUsd}
6. GET /metrics:
   - Returns {calls_today, cost_today_usd, per_tier: {[tier]: {calls, cost_usd, p50_ms, p95_ms}}}
   - Compute p50/p95 from latencyMs arrays
7. Start server: const port = parseInt(process.env.CLAWROUTER_PORT ?? '3101'); app.listen(port, () => console.log('[ClawRouter HTTP] listening on :'+port))
8. Keep file UNDER 150 lines.
